title: Full Stack Dev (Angular + C#) 3-6 Y
description:
Hello Visionary!
  
  
We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future.
  
  
Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant team.
  
  
**We’re looking for a Full Stack Developer (Angular + C# .NET | AWS)**
**You’ll Make a Difference By**

* Developing cloud-based applications with intuitive interfaces to monitor, analyze, and optimize building and campus energy utilization
* Designing and implementing scalable, cloud-native applications using Angular and C# (.NET Core)
* Collaborating with cross-functional, international Scrum teams to estimate, plan, and deliver high-quality software components
* Participating in system integration, integration testing, and automation to ensure application reliability
* Driving CI/CD pipelines and contributing to configuration management and continuous deployment practices
* Documenting software designs and development activities to ensure long-term maintainability and extensibility
* Following secure and compliant product development processes, while contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.

**You’ll Win Us Over By**

* Holding a degree in B.E./B.Tech/MCA/M.Sc in Computer Science / IT or related field
* Having 3+ years of software development experience, including at least 2 years in AWS cloud-native application development using Angular and C# (.NET Core)
* Strong expertise in object-oriented programming and thorough testing practices
* Hands-on experience with GitLab CI/CD and Docker-based development environments
* Solid understanding of AWS cloud services, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Experience using development tools like Visual Studio Code, IntelliJ, or Eclipse
* Strong communication skills in English (written and verbal)
* A proactive mindset with strong ownership, quality focus, and engineering excellence

**Bonus Points For**

* Experience with AWS services such as Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway, SNS/SQS, CloudWatch, and Serverless architectures
* Hands-on experience with Terraform and infrastructure as code
* Experience in test automation (unit & integration testing)
* Familiarity with tools like Git and SonarQube
* Working experience in Agile methodologies (Scrum ceremonies, sprint planning, retrospectives, clean code practices)
* Exposure to Test-Driven Development (TDD), code refactoring, and performance profiling
* Experience working in international virtual teams
* Certifications in C#, Python, Go, or related technologies.

**What You’ll Gain**

* Opportunity to work on innovative cloud-based energy optimization solutions
* Collaboration with global, cross-functional teams in an agile environment
* Exposure to modern technologies in cloud, containerization, and scalable architectures
* A culture that values ownership, quality, and continuous learning

**Create a better #TomorrowWithUs!**
This role, based in Chennai, is an individual contributor position. You may be required to visit other locations within India and internationally. In return, you'll have the opportunity to work with teams shaping the future.
  
  
At Siemens, we are a collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time, worldwide. We are dedicated to equality and welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.
  
  
Bring your curiosity and imagination, and help us shape tomorrow .
  
  
Find out more about Siemens careers at: www.siemens.com/careers #STS

title: AVP, Full Stack Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**
Lead the design, development and delivery of secure, scalable and resilient enterprise applications across front-end, back-end, API and data layers. The role combines hands-on full stack engineering with technical leadership and stakeholder management, translating business priorities into well-governed technology solutions and driving delivery across product, architecture, security, operations and engineering teams
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as an individual contributor with technical leadership accountability for end-to-end full stack solution delivery.
* Design, build and maintain responsive web applications using modern front-end frameworks and reusable component patterns.
* Develop secure back-end services, REST APIs, microservices and event-driven integrations.
* Create high-level and low-level designs covering application, integration, data, security, resilience and deployment considerations.
* Drive engineering quality through code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, DevSecOps, observability and performance optimisation.
* Partner with business stakeholders, product owners and analysts to clarify requirements, priorities, outcomes and acceptance criteria.
* Influence architecture, security, risk and operations stakeholders by clearly communicating options, trade-offs, dependencies and recommendations.

**Cloud-native APIs, Microservices and Integration**
**DevSecOps, CI/CD, Testing and Observability**
15+ years of software engineering experience, including enterprise-scale full stack delivery; strong hands-on experience with a modern front-end framework and Java/Spring Boot, .NET, Python or Node.js back-end services; experience with APIs, microservices, SQL/NoSQL, cloud platforms, containers, CI/CD and production support; proven stakeholder management across business, product, architecture, security, risk and operations.
  
  
**Motivations**

* Solving complex enterprise architecture and data-engineering challenges.

**Qualifications**
**Key Experiences**

**About Standard Chartered**
We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. * Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

**What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,**
we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  
  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.

* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
description:
Software Development
  
  
Join Royal York Property Management as a Senior Full-Stack Developer to lead the architecture and maintenance of our key web portals and client applications. Work with cutting-edge AI tools in a remote, dynamic environment.
  
  
**About Royal York Property Management**
At Royal York Property Management, we take pride in managing our clients' investment properties with the same dedication and care as we would our own. Our approach to property management is meticulous, whether it involves addressing maintenance emergencies or conducting tenant showings. In every task, we consider whether the standards we apply are equivalent to those we would expect for our properties. Prioritizing the needs of our clients and tenants is at the forefront of our mission, ensuring we deliver exceptional service every day.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Senior Full-Stack Developer at Royal York Property Management, you will be responsible for architecting, scaling, and maintaining our core web platforms. You will play a vital role in managing complex backend ecosystems using Laravel and dynamic frontends with Vue.js, ensuring seamless integration with third-party APIs like Google Ads and Zoho. Your expertise will guide the development of secure, scalable, and fast-delivery features using AI-assisted coding workflows.
  
  
In your day-to-day, you'll write clean and maintainable backend code, develop reactive UI components, and manage API endpoints and webhooks. You will leverage AI tools to enhance development speed and maintain a robust architectural structure across projects. You will work closely with our technical leads, operating with high autonomy to design and execute high-level project requirements into functional systems.
  
  
Success in this role means delivering modular, scalable features rapidly, achieving zero critical downtime, and ensuring robust security implementations. You'll excel if you take a proactive approach to security, love clean architecture, and possess a flair for integrating AI workflows into traditional coding practices.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Architect and maintain core web portals and client applications using Laravel and Vue.js.
* Write clean, maintainable backend business logic in Laravel and develop reactive UI components in Vue.js.
* Design, test, and monitor external API endpoints, handle incoming and outgoing webhook payloads, and trace debug logs.
* Utilize AI coding assistants to rapidly prototype and refactor code, and write comprehensive test suites.
* Review code architecture, optimize database queries, and ensure security compliance across active projects.
* Deliver major feature sprints, verify webhook reliability, and perform code reviews.
* Conduct security audits, optimize API rate-usage tracking, and update technical documentation.
* Architect new multi-tenant modules, refactor legacy architecture, and troubleshoot complex production scaling bottlenecks.
* Achieve zero critical downtime in production and implement clean API error handling and robust security measures.
* Build and document robust, fault-tolerant API integrations with error recovery and rate-limit handling.
* Deliver scalable, secure, and modular features rapidly using modern AI-assisted development workflows.
* Difficulties arise when handling asynchronous event/APIs, ignoring security fundamentals, or relying on outdated development methods.
* Debug broken or delayed webhook payloads, manage API quota suspensions, and resolve security vulnerabilities under tight deadlines.

What we are looking for
  
  

* Minimum of 6 years of hands-on software development experience building production-grade web applications.
* Deep expertise in PHP and Laravel for backend development. Proficiency in frontend development with a strong grasp of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and familiarity with frameworks and libraries such as Tailwind CSS and Vue.js.
* Extensive experience in REST APIs, OAuth protocols, and Webhooks. Knowledge of various third-party platforms like Payment Gateways, Google Ads, Google Analytics, and Zoho for integrations.
* Strong knowledge of comprehensive web security best practices, including CSRF, XSS protection, secure authentication methods, data encryption, and safe payload validation.
* Proficiency in Git for version control, and experience with deployment on cloud platforms such as AWS and Cloudways.
* Familiarity with SSH and command-line tools for efficient server management and deployment.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* English — fluent, spoken and written.

Nice to have
  
  

* Python proficiency is an advantage, especially for potential integration or data-driven tasks.
* Experience with AI-assisted development tools to enhance coding speed and quality is preferred.

What we offer
  
  
CAD $24,000 to $40,000 per year.
  
  
Schedule
  
  
Full-Time, Mon-Fri, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM.
  
  
What happens next
  
  
Our recruitment partner will be in touch with you about your application.
  
  
If you meet the requirements for the role, they will send you a link to an online video interview that you complete in your own time — there is no appointment to book and nothing to install.
  
  
Your completed interview is then shared with us to review alongside your application, and we will let you know what happens next.

title: Senior Engineer- Dot Net
description:
**About Us**
We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.
  
  
As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.
  
  
**About Energy Systems**
We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Senior Software Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting production-grade software products and shared platform capabilities within DNV’s Digital & Transformation organization. This role sits within the Application Engineering section and contributes to the development and modernization of scalable web applications that support digital delivery across Energy Systems.
  
  
This role helps to advance how DNV performs Due Diligence, Verification & Assurance, and Renewables Certification work across Energy Systems.
  
  
This is not a project-based delivery or staff-augmentation role. Engineers are expected to develop deep product knowledge and remain accountable for the quality, maintainability, and operation of the software they build.
  
  
Working in close partnership with Frontend Engineers, Product leadership, Data & AI Engineering, Solution Engineering, Platform Reliability, Solution Architecture, and Platform Security & Compliance, this role helps bring application capabilities, data services, AI-enabled features, workflows, and APIs into one cohesive platform and product experience.
  
  
The Senior Software Engineer designs, builds, tests, deploys, and supports scalable software across a modern Microsoft-oriented full-stack environment. The primary stack includes C# and .NET 10, Entity Framework Core, SignalR, MySQL, Redis, TypeScript, React, Redux, Tailwind CSS, Docker, .NET Aspire, Azure Functions, Azure Storage, Azure AI Search, and Azure DevOps. The role requires strong engineering fundamentals, practical cloud experience, and the ability to collaborate effectively across globally distributed teams.
  
  
This role supports custom software development, application modernization, and integration with low-code or hybrid development environments, helping establish shared patterns, APIs, reusable components, and maintainable application architecture across the platform.
  
  
\*\*This role is based at our DNV office in Chennai, India. Further details regarding role-specific requirements will be shared during the interview process.\*\*
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Software Engineering & Delivery**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable application and platform capabilities using modern software engineering practices.
* Build cohesive product experiences across backend services, APIs and platform integrations.
* Work directly with Product and Architecture stakeholders to shape requirements, evaluate technical approaches, and translate product direction into maintainable, production-ready software.
* Participate actively in code reviews, technical design discussions, estimation, delivery planning, and implementation decisions.
* Write clean, well-structured, testable, and maintainable code that supports long-term product quality and team velocity.
* Own product capabilities through design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and iterative improvement rather than treating delivery as complete when the initial feature is released.
* NET Application Development
* Develop modern API capabilities using C#, .NET 10, Entity Framework Core, SignalR, and related technologies.
* Develop solutions for Azure and contribute to their deployment and support.
* Support application modernization efforts, including refactoring, technical debt reduction, framework upgrades, and migration from legacy patterns where appropriate.
* Develop application capabilities used for structured review workflows, real-time collaboration, issue tracking, customer interaction, reporting, and delivery of technical work products.
* Partner with Product and design stakeholders to ensure application functionality is intuitive, reliable, and aligned with user workflows.
* Develop APIs, backend services, frontend components, and integration patterns that support platform interoperability.
* Help integrate applications with data services, AI-enabled capabilities, workflow configurations, authentication patterns, and enterprise systems.
* Contribute to reusable development patterns, documentation, and engineering practices that improve team velocity and consistency.
* Integrate data-driven, search, agentic, and AI-enabled capabilities into production web applications using well-defined APIs and reusable application patterns.

**Modern Development & AI-Enabled Engineering**

* Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, testing, debugging, documentation, refactoring, and engineering analysis.
* Apply strong engineering judgment when using LLM-enabled workflows, ensuring generated or assisted code meets standards for quality, security, maintainability, and performance.
* Use AI-enabled tools where appropriate to support test generation, code review preparation, technical documentation, and developer productivity.

**DevOps, Reliability & Security**

* Contribute to Azure DevOps repositories and pipelines, automated testing, deployment automation, environment management, monitoring, and incident readiness.
* Build software using an Agile methodology, with strong attention to reliability, performance, availability, scalability, and operational support.
* Support observability practices including logging, monitoring, error handling, and production diagnostics.
* Follow secure development practices aligned with internal security standards, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and enterprise security expectations.
* Collaborate with Platform Reliability, Security, and Global Shared Services teams to support secure, reliable, and maintainable production systems.

**Collaboration & Technical Ownership**

* Work effectively with Product, Solution Engineering, Data & AI Engineering, Platform Reliability, Architecture, Security, and regional teams in a globally distributed environment.
* Take ownership of assigned features, services, defects, and technical improvements from design through production support.
* Communicate technical trade-offs clearly and contribute to pragmatic engineering decisions.
* Mentor less experienced engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, pairing, and shared engineering practices.
* Contribute to a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and delivery excellence.
* Contribute actively within planning and design meetings, speaking up where potential issues arise or where a requirement is poorly defined.
* Champion potential solutions to problems and communicate them clearly to the team.

What we offer
  
  

* Flexible work arrangements for better work-life balance
* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave)
* Medical benefits ( Insurance and Annual Health Check-up)
* Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance)
* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On-The-Job Training, Training Programme)
* Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement)
* Company bonus/Profit share.

\*Benefits may vary based on position, tenure/contract/grade level\*
  
  
DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
  
  
**About You**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of experience developing production software in application engineering, software engineering, platform engineering, or related technical roles.
* Strong production experience developing backend applications and services using C# and modern .NET.
* Experience designing REST APIs and building distributed or service-oriented application capabilities.
* Deep understanding of SQL and database optimisation.
* Experience building, modernizing, or operating scalable web applications in production environments, especially applications that support complex workflows, collaboration, reporting, document review, or customer-facing delivery.
* Experience building APIs, backend services, frontend components, integrations, and application capabilities in production environments.
* Experience developing, deploying, and supporting cloud-hosted applications, with practical experience in Microsoft Azure strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of software design, testing, code quality, maintainability, security, and performance.
* Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, source control, code review, and modern software delivery practices.
* Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development tools or LLM-enabled coding workflows to improve development productivity.
* Ability to collaborate with Product, Architecture, Security, Platform Reliability, and cross-functional stakeholders in a matrixed environment.
* Strong English communication skills and ability to work effectively across globally distributed teams.

**What Is Preferred**

* Experience in Search, RAG or AI integration technologies.
* Experience of real-time collaboration or data syncing with technologies such as SignalR or WebSockets.
* Experience in frontend systems such as React or Blazor.
* Experience in product-led or platform-based organizations.
* Familiarity with low-code or hybrid development environments.
* Experience with collaborative due diligence, document review, workflow, reporting, Q&A, risk management, or transaction delivery applications.
* Experience supporting interoperability across multiple systems or enterprise platforms.
* Experience working in a broader multi-cloud enterprise environment, including familiarity with AWS.
* Background in energy, infrastructure, renewables, assurance, certification, or other technically complex industries.
* Experience with multi-cloud environments spanning Azure and AWS.
* Experience modernizing legacy applications or integrating acquired software products into a broader enterprise platform.

Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country-specific laws and practices.

title: Servicenow-Application Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Technology Consulting**
**Title: Application Engineer - III**
EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
  
  
Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
  
  
**EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
  
  
**EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:**
Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
  
  
Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
  
  
Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.
  
  
**The opportunity**
This role provides advanced-level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases under general direction, and leads backend optimization, data integration, documentation, and secure, scalable architecture aligned with enterprise standards.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provides senior level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases. Integrates third party products.
* Translates technical specifications into code for complex new or enhancement projects for internal clients. Writes programs, develops code, tests artifacts, and produces reports. Employs software development techniques to ensure tests are implemented in a way that support automation.
* Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.
* Elevates code into the development, test, and production environments on schedule. Provides follow up production support. Submits change control requests and documents.
* Thoroughly understands software development methodology. Thoroughly understands development architecture standards. Trains and mentors staff with less experience. Resolves elevated issues.
* Participates in design, code, and test inspections throughout the life cycle to identify issues. Explains technical considerations at related meetings, including those with internal clients. Performs systems analysis activities.
* Thoroughly understands client business functions and technology needs. Has a broad understanding of Vanguard's technologies, tools, and applications, including those that interface with business area and systems.
* Interfaces with cross functional team members, and communicates systems issues at the appropriate technical level for each audience.
* Thoroughly understands and complies with Information Technology and Information Security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders
* Must Have skills : AWS Full stack Java required.
* Typescript

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in software development, system integration, database design, and back-end architecture.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in relevant fields such as Computer Science, or a Master’s degree/Diploma in Computer Science.
* Expertise in server-side development, system integration, and API management; strong knowledge of database design, optimization, debugging, and performance tuning.
* Must-have skills: Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Node JS, AWS, CloudFormation, ECS, Fargate, DynamoDB, S3, Lambda, IAM, SQL queries, GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, CI/CD, TDD/BDD, Splunk, Honeycomb, Python.
* Knowledge of Agile, Confluence, JIRA; aptitude for continuous process improvement for process flows/workflows.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)

**What We Look For**

* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.

**What Working At EY Offers**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Description**
At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd
  
  
**ITS Vice Presidency Context**
The Information and Technology Solutions (ITS) Vice Presidential Unit (VPU) enables the World Bank Group to achieve its mission of ending extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity on a livable planet by delivering transformative information and technologies to its staff working in over 150+ locations. For more information on ITS, see this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?reload=9&v=VTFGffa1Y7w
  
  
**Department Context**
The ITS Operations Products unit (ITSOP) enables the Bank's operational business processes through modern, flexible and user-friendly digital products. Its portfolio includes Operations Workspace and related solutions that bring together operational data, documents, workflows, collaboration and decision support for front-line staff.
  
  
ITSOP is seeking an Associate Senior Solutions Architect to provide hands-on architecture and engineering leadership for the Operations Workspace ecosystem. The successful candidate will combine deep Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse expertise with strong .NET and Azure engineering skills, personally implement prototypes and reference solutions, and guide delivery teams from design through production. The role will also help integrate Generative AI and agentic capabilities into operational workflows using a governed AI Development Lifecycle (ADLC). This is not a purely advisory role.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The Associate Senior Solutions Architect translates complex operational requirements into secure, scalable and maintainable solutions across Dynamics 365, Dataverse, .NET, Azure, APIs, data platforms and AI services. The role defines architecture, validates choices through working code, establishes reusable patterns and guardrails, and remains directly engaged in troubleshooting, CI/CD, release readiness and production improvement.
  
  
**Duties And Accountabilities**
The Associate Senior Solutions Architect works across multiple projects in the World Bank Operations portfolio and is accountable for ensuring that technical solutions are successfully designed, delivered and operated for Operations staff.
  
  
From a work-program perspective, the role provides technical leadership, delivery oversight and practical guidance to internal staff and globally distributed vendor teams. The architect helps sequence technical work, resolves delivery constraints and ensures that implementation remains aligned with business priorities, enterprise standards and release commitments.
  
  
From a technical perspective, the role leads application, integration and data architecture; identifies solution components and reusable patterns; validates designs through working prototypes; performs quality and code reviews; and remains accountable for delivery at speed, scale and quality.
  
  
**Role Scope and Distinction**

* Acts as a senior technical subject matter expert for complex, business-critical solutions in the Operations Workspace portfolio.
* Balances strategic architecture with recent, demonstrable hands-on contribution to prototypes, code, integration, deployment and technical problem-solving.
* Leads cross-layer design decisions involving applications, workflows, data, APIs, identity, security, observability and AI-enabled experiences.
* Guides multidisciplinary teams and vendors, mentors architects and engineers, and raises engineering quality through practical standards and reusable implementation assets.
* Works across globally distributed business, product, architecture, security, data, platform and engineering stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership**

* Lead end-to-end solution architecture for Operations Workspace and related products, aligning business outcomes, enterprise principles, security requirements and delivery constraints.
* Define target-state and transition architectures, solution options, architecture decision records, integration contracts, non-functional requirements and implementation roadmaps.
* Review designs and code for scalability, resilience, maintainability, interoperability, usability, performance and cost effectiveness.
* Identify systemic risks and technical debt, propose pragmatic remediation, and guide Agile Release Train and product teams through implementation trade-offs.

Lead solution delivery teams through implementation, maintenance, release readiness and operational improvement of business-critical applications supporting Operations Workspace and related Operations product ecosystems.
  
  
Lead application and data architecture modelling, component identification and solution quality reviews, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture principles and approved technology standards.
  
  
**Dynamics 365 and Dataverse Engineering**

* Architect and implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse solutions, including data models, security roles, business rules, workflows, plug-ins, custom actions, Power Platform components and environment strategy.
* Design supported extension patterns using C#/.NET, the Dataverse SDK and APIs while minimizing fragile customization and preserving upgradeability.
* Guide integration of Dynamics 365 with SharePoint Online, Microsoft Graph, Azure services, enterprise data products and other operational systems.
* Define application lifecycle management practices for solutions, configuration, environment variables, connection references, test data and controlled promotion across environments.

**Hands-on Prototyping and .NET Engineering**

* Personally design, code, test and demonstrate proofs of concept, technical spikes, reference implementations and minimum viable solutions.
* Develop secure APIs, services, plug-ins and integration components using C#, modern .NET, ASP.NET Core and RESTful patterns.
* Validate architecture choices through executable prototypes, performance tests and failure-mode testing before major delivery investment.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across user experience, application, integration, identity, data and infrastructure layers, and support teams during critical releases.

**Integration, Cloud and Platform Architecture**

* Design API-led, event-driven and workflow-based integrations using appropriate Azure services, API management, messaging, serverless and container patterns.
* Apply identity-first design using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, least privilege, secrets management and auditable authorization patterns, including B2E and approved external-access scenarios.
* Define observability using structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics, dashboards and actionable alerts across application and integration components.
* Collaborate with data and platform teams to connect operational applications to governed data services, analytics products and structured and unstructured enterprise information.

Design integrations with institutional systems and data platforms, including financing, trust funds, board operations, budgeting, SAP and enterprise data services, using supported APIs, events and workflow patterns.
  
  
Architect document and content-management integrations across Dynamics 365, SharePoint Online and approved cloud services, including secure storage, metadata, retrieval and downstream AI processing.
  
  
**Agentic AI and AI-enabled Operations**

* Design and prototype AI-enabled features and agentic workflows embedded in Operations Workspace, with explicit task boundaries, approved tools, controlled permissions, human review and failure handling.
* Integrate agents with Dynamics 365, enterprise APIs, documents, data platforms and business workflows using secure tool calling, structured outputs and reusable orchestration patterns.
* Apply retrieval-augmented generation, document intelligence and knowledge-grounding approaches where they improve operational workflows and decision support.
* Define evaluation, telemetry and guardrails for groundedness, task success, safety, latency, reliability and cost, and ensure Responsible AI, privacy, records and security requirements are addressed.

Partner with information security teams on architecture reviews, threat modelling, control implementation, security testing and remediation evidence required for production approval.
  
  
**Delivery Lifecycle, CI/CD and Engineering Excellence**

* Establish and improve CI/CD pipelines for Dynamics 365 solutions, .NET services, infrastructure configuration and AI components using Azure DevOps or equivalent enterprise tooling.
* Embed automated unit, integration, contract, security, regression and performance testing into delivery pipelines, with quality gates, approvals, release evidence and rollback approaches.
* Apply both the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and a governed AI Development Lifecycle (ADLC), covering use-case framing, data and grounding readiness, prompt and tool versioning, evaluation, deployment, monitoring and change control.
* Create reusable templates, starter repositories, SDKs, reference pipelines, coding standards and implementation guidance that improve developer productivity and consistency.

**Stakeholder, Vendor and Team Leadership**

* Translate operational needs into feasible technical choices and communicate architecture decisions and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Provide practical technical direction to internal teams and vendors, review deliverables against agreed architecture and quality expectations, and intervene hands-on where necessary.
* Mentor architects and engineers through pairing, design reviews, code reviews, demonstrations and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Partner with product leadership to sequence enablers, reduce delivery risk and ensure technical work results in measurable operational value.

Provide work-program oversight for internal and vendor delivery teams across locations, assess deliverable quality, remove technical blockers and hold suppliers accountable for agreed architecture, engineering and documentation standards.
  
  
Selection Criteria
  
  

* Master's degree with at least eight years of relevant experience, or bachelor's degree with at least ten years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, in computer science, software engineering, information systems or a related field.
* Substantial recent experience architecting and delivering large-scale enterprise applications using Microsoft Dynamics 365, Dataverse, .NET and Azure.
* Demonstrated hands-on contribution to production solutions, including personal coding, prototyping, integration, troubleshooting and deployment responsibilities.
* Experience leading complex delivery across internal staff, vendors and globally distributed teams in environments with strong governance, security and operational requirements.
* At least seven years of experience developing and maintaining large-scale solutions using C# and the Microsoft .NET ecosystem.
* At least five years of experience architecting Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Dataverse solutions and integrations with SharePoint Online, Azure services and enterprise or on-premises systems.
* Proven experience leading large, complex technical deliverables and globally distributed development teams, including vendor or offshore delivery, in environments with shifting priorities and multi-layered governance.

**Required Technical Capabilities**

* Advanced Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse architecture, including data modelling, security, workflows, plug-ins, custom APIs, Power Platform extensibility and solution ALM.
* Advanced C# and modern .NET engineering, including ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, dependency injection, asynchronous programming, automated testing and secure coding.
* Strong Azure application architecture experience, including App Service, Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault, Application Insights, storage and container-based deployment patterns.
* Strong systems integration capability across APIs, events, enterprise applications, Microsoft 365 services, SharePoint Online and data platforms.
* Hands-on CI/CD and DevSecOps experience, including source control, branching, build and release pipelines, infrastructure/configuration automation, quality gates, secrets handling and rollback.
* Practical experience designing or implementing Generative AI and agentic capabilities, including tool calling, orchestration, retrieval, structured outputs, evaluation, observability and human oversight.
* Ability to apply SDLC and ADLC controls to move prototypes into secure, supportable and production-ready services.
* Strong security architecture knowledge covering identity, authorization, least privilege, data protection, auditability, threat modelling and secure integration.
* Ability to produce clear architecture documentation and to explain decisions, alternatives, risks and trade-offs to varied audiences.
* Hands-on experience extending Dynamics 365 using C#/.NET plug-ins, custom APIs, workflows and supported client-side technologies, with strong knowledge of Dataverse security, data modelling and reporting capabilities.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization using Microsoft Entra ID, including B2E and approved B2B scenarios.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Operations Workspace, operational process platforms, project or portfolio management solutions, or comparable enterprise CRM/workflow ecosystems.
* Experience with Angular or React and modern web application integration with .NET and Dynamics 365 back ends.
* Experience with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Semantic Kernel or comparable enterprise agent frameworks.
* Experience with document intelligence, enterprise search, RAG, semantic layers, knowledge graphs or governed access to structured and unstructured information.
* Experience with SAFe, Agile Release Trains, product operating models and architecture governance.
* Experience in international development, financial services or another regulated environment with strong privacy, security and audit requirements.
* Relevant Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, DevOps, security or architecture certifications.
* Working knowledge of enterprise data and analytics platforms, including data lakes, data warehouses, Power BI, Azure Data Factory, Databricks or comparable integration and analytics services.

**Recommended Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.

* SAFe for Architects (ARCH) and/or SAFe DevOps (SDP).

title: Sitecore Development Lead
description:
**Job Family**
Software Application & Development (India)
  
  
**Travel Required**
None
  
  
**Clearance Required**
None
  
  
**What You Will Do**
We are seeking a Sitecore Developer to build, enhance, and support our enterprise digital experience platform, with a strong focus on SitecoreAI-enabled development. In this role, you will translate business, content, and design requirements into secure, scalable, and high-performing Sitecore solutions; develop reusable components, integrations, and AI-assisted capabilities; and help ensure reliable releases. You will work closely with the Sitecore Architect, developers, content teams, marketing stakeholders, analytics teams, and external partners to deliver maintainable experiences using Sitecore XM Cloud, SitecoreAI, React, Next.js, the Sitecore Content SDK, GraphQL, Experience Edge, Vercel, and modern cloud delivery practices.
  
  

* Develop reusable, accessible headless components and intuitive authoring experiences that translate approved designs into maintainable application code.
* Build and integrate SitecoreAI capabilities that improve content creation, content discovery, search relevance, personalization, and digital experience delivery while following approved governance and security standards.
* Configure content models, templates, validation rules, metadata, and publishing workflows in partnership with content owners, with clear documentation for authors and support teams.
* Develop and maintain integrations with enterprise platforms, including CRM, CDP, analytics, identity, consent management, search, marketing automation, and approved AI services.
* Collaborate with the Sitecore Architect and delivery partners on technical designs, implementation standards, AI development patterns, platform governance, and release planning.
* Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly to accelerate coding, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and content operations while validating outputs for accuracy, security, performance, accessibility, and maintainability.
* Participate in code reviews, automated testing, deployment coordination, and production readiness activities; provide practical guidance to other developers when needed.
* Optimize application performance, accessibility, security, SEO, AEO, GEO, caching, search discoverability, and content delivery across environments.
* Diagnose and resolve complex defects and production issues involving rendering, APIs, integrations, AI-enabled features, and content delivery using logs, monitoring, and root-cause analysis.
* Contribute to cloud and hosting decisions related to scalability, resilience, observability, and cost efficiency within the established architecture.
* Implement approved personalization capabilities and privacy-conscious analytics events, including GA4 event contracts, in coordination with analytics and integration teams.
* Identify and recommend improvements to development practices, AI tooling, prompt and evaluation approaches, documentation, and platform capabilities that increase quality and delivery efficiency.

**What You Will Need**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* At least 4 years of software development experience, including hands-on delivery of Sitecore-based digital platforms in enterprise environments.
* Hands-on experience developing headless Sitecore XM Cloud solutions using React, Next.js, Sitecore JSS or the Sitecore Content SDK, Experience Edge, and Vercel.
* Experience implementing or extending SitecoreAI features, AI-assisted content workflows, intelligent search or discovery, personalization, or related generative AI capabilities within a digital experience platform.
* Proficiency with JavaScript or TypeScript, component-based development, HTML, CSS, REST APIs, GraphQL, and integration patterns for approved AI services.
* Experience with content modeling, templates, component configuration, metadata, publishing workflows, and authoring experiences in Sitecore.
* Working knowledge of Sitecore Helix principles, headless implementation patterns, composable DXP architecture, and responsible AI development practices.
* Ability to design prompts, structured inputs, guardrails, and practical evaluation scenarios for AI-enabled features, and to assess outputs for quality, relevance, accuracy, privacy, and security.
* Experience with Git-based development, pull requests, automated testing, and CI/CD deployment practices.
* Experience integrating Sitecore with third-party and enterprise systems, such as analytics, identity, CRM, consent management, search, marketing platforms, or AI services.
* Ability to diagnose application, rendering, caching, API, deployment, AI integration, and content-delivery issues across environments.
* Understanding of web security, data privacy, accessibility, scalability, performance optimization, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), and generative engine optimization (GEO).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical and AI-related decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively in a hybrid, cross-functional delivery environment.
* Ability to support peers through code reviews, troubleshooting, documentation, and knowledge sharing while aligning with the Sitecore Architect’s technical direction.

**What Would Be Nice To Have**

* Experience with additional Sitecore products, such as Content Hub, Search, CDP, Personalize, or SXA.
* Experience developing with large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, AI APIs, or agent-based workflows in an enterprise environment.
* Familiarity with AI evaluation, prompt management, content governance, responsible AI principles, and monitoring of AI-enabled experiences.
* Experience delivering solutions on Microsoft Azure or another major cloud platform.
* Familiarity with automated unit, integration, accessibility, performance, and visual regression testing.
* Sitecore certification or equivalent demonstrated expertise.
* Experience working in regulated, high-traffic, or complex enterprise environments.
* Strong presentation and stakeholder management skills.

description:

****Job Description:****

Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
Role Definition
  
  
Develop, maintain, and modernize Java and Angular-based enterprise applications by transforming traditional Agile software development practices into an Agentic SDLC using Caterpillar-approved AI frameworks, development tools, and governance standards to accelerate solution delivery, improve software quality, and enhance engineering productivity.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, implement, and maintain enterprise software applications using Agile and Agentic Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices, leveraging Caterpillar-approved AI frameworks, tools, and engineering standards.
* Collaborate with business partners and stakeholders to capture requirements, refine user stories, and optimize business workflows through intelligent automation and AI-assisted solution design.
* Develop, enhance, and maintain application code using AI-assisted development tools, including generation, review, refactoring, documentation, and optimization of software components.
* Utilize agentic development frameworks and automated testing tools to accelerate test creation, validation, quality assurance, deployment, and ongoing application maintenance.
* Leverage AI agents throughout the SDLC to support requirements analysis, architecture design, code generation, testing, documentation, DevOps, and production support activities.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity, software quality, and delivery velocity through the adoption of agentic development practices and intelligent automation.
* Assists clients with implementing new products, new releases and software upgrades. Responds to inquiries and requests from clients.
* Participates in analysis of client identified issues or problems which may require changes to software, procedures, or documentation.
* Diagnoses, troubleshoots and resolves common technical problems. Escalates as per procedures.

Skill Descriptors
  
  
Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Reviews others' writing or presentations and provides feedback and coaching.
* Adapts documents and presentations for the intended audience.
* Demonstrates both empathy and assertiveness when communicating a need or defending a position.
* Communicates well downward, upward, and outward.
* Employs appropriate methods of persuasion when soliciting agreement.
* Maintains focus on the topic at hand.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
* Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
* Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
* Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
* Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

Customer Support Policies, Standards and Procedures: Knowledge of the organization's customer support policies, standards and procedures; ability to guide customers on all company interactions.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Collaborates with other functions on establishing and documenting joint standards.
* Develops quality assurance and monitoring mechanisms.
* Advises on the development of customer support policies and practices.
* Implements cross-functional standards and procedures.
* Evaluates the impact of standards and policies across functional specialties.
* Analyzes existing and evolving procedures for their efficiency and effectiveness.

Software Product Technical Knowledge: Knowledge of technical aspects of a software products; ability to design, configure and integrate technical aspects of software products.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Supports and participates in major installations and customizations.
* Has knowledge of all technical and infrastructure components of the software product.
* Maintains and disseminates information on customer platforms and experiences.
* Collects, documents and maintains product configuration requirements and instances.
* Provides recommendations and documentation to field support on technical and platform issues.
* Elaborates on alternative product configurations, platforms, and implementation options.

Software Release Management: Knowledge of strategies, practices and tools for managing versions and distribution of software products and enhancements; ability to evaluate and improve release management practices and tools.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Participates in the development and testing of back-out procedures and recovery strategies.
* Oversees all aspects of release management for the entire installed customer base.
* Develops and disseminates communications about new release training.
* Drafts communications about product release delays.
* Develops distribution dates based on development, testing (QA), validation, packaging activities.
* Conducts impact analysis for major releases or critical applications; assesses benefits and risks.

Software Reliability Management: Knowledge of software reliability management; ability to develop and use principles, methodologies and metrics that increase software product performance and reliability.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Explains the process and considerations for defining product reliability requirements.
* Describes tools for gathering reliability information on installed products.
* Identifies reliability activities and tasks for the product development and maintenance plans.
* Monitors and analyzes system failures and corrective actions.
* Works with reliability testing methods and tools.

Performance Measurement and Tuning: Knowledge of system performance, testing and programming; ability to monitor, measure, and optimize system performance and network communication.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Monitors the performance of specific system components.
* Researches performance objectives and requirements for a component or application.
* Works with installed software tools for performance monitoring and reporting.
* Validates performance characteristics for specific technologies.
* Works with the performance measurements of hardware, software or network components.Technical Troubleshooting: Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation.

**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Emphasizes the business impact of failure and the criticality and timing of needed resolution so that problems can be avoided in the future.
* Creates trouble reports for all issues found and reviews solutions for completeness and correctness.
* Directs the resolution of communications problems in multi-vendor environments.
* Resolves a variety of hardware, software, and communications malfunctions.
* Coaches others on advanced diagnostic techniques and tools for unusual or performance-related problems.
* Facilitates the distribution of releases reports and correction packages to departments or clients.

title: Java Angular Full Stack Development Lead - Vice President
description:
The
**Full Stack Development Lead Analyst (Digital Software Engineering Lead)**
is a senior technical and people leadership professional who drives end-to-end engineering excellence, architecture, and delivery across web, mobile, API, microservices, and AI-enabled digital ecosystems. This role acts as a recognized technical authority and managerial leader, steering application development strategy with deep hands-on expertise in
**Java**
,
**Angular**
,
**Microservices architectures**
,
**REST/GraphQL APIs**
,
**Mobile/Web platforms**
, and
**modern AI engineering tools & GenAI integrations**
.
  
  
The role combines strategic direction, architectural governance (Next Gen Architecture / NGA), hands-on technical mentoring, and engineering team leadership. The Lead Manager guides cross-functional engineering teams, promotes the adoption of AI-assisted software development practices (e.g., AI coding assistants, automated test generation, and GenAI gateway/model integrations), collaborates closely with Product Managers, Technical Program Managers (TPMs), and Enterprise Architects, and influences stakeholders across lines of business (LOBs) to deliver scalable, secure, and resilient digital solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Leadership & Full Stack Engineering Delivery
* End-to-End Full Stack Ownership: Lead the design, development, testing, and deployment of mission-critical, enterprise-grade web and mobile applications powered by modern Java microservices backends and Angular frontends.
* Architecture & Modernization: Drive adoption of Next Gen Architecture (NGA) and Plan of Record (POR) standards across microservices, distributed caching, event-driven systems (Kafka/MQ), and cloud-native container platforms.
* API Strategy & Integration: Architect robust, secure, and scalable RESTful and GraphQL APIs, ensuring adherence to enterprise API lifecycle standards, versioning, security protocols (OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS), and API gateway patterns.
* Web & Mobile Development Leadership: Guide teams in building high-performance, responsive web applications in Angular (TypeScript, RxJS, NgRx/State Management) and modern mobile experiences (native/hybrid/responsive mobile frameworks), ensuring seamless cross-platform performance and accessibility (WCAG).
* Delivery Management: Serve as development lead and engineering manager for multiple concurrent large-scale digital initiatives, establishing clear delivery roadmaps, managing technical debt, and resolving complex cross-team dependencies across Agile and hybrid delivery models.
* AI-Assisted Engineering & Innovation
* AI Tooling & SDLC Productivity: Champion and drive team adoption of generative AI developer tools and AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, AI code review and test generation tools) to enhance developer productivity, code quality, and time-to-market.
* GenAI & LLM Integration: Guide architectural patterns for integrating GenAI capabilities, LLM endpoints, semantic search/vector retrieval, AI gateways, and prompt-driven microservices into enterprise web and mobile applications.
* AI Governance & Quality Gates: Ensure that AI-generated code, prompt structures, and GenAI integrations adhere to firm-wide security, privacy, guardrails, compliance, and IP protection standards.
* Architecture Governance, Design & Code Reviews
* Design Review Board & Patterns: Act as a core member of the Design Review Board to evaluate system architectures, establish generic reusable design patterns, and enforce enterprise CTO guidelines across digital domains.
* Code & Quality Governance: Champion rigorous code reviews for Java microservices, Angular applications, mobile modules, and CI/CD pipelines, ensuring high code quality, security posture (SAST/DAST/OSS scanning), performance benchmarking, and test coverage.
* Metrics & Observability: Establish and track clear engineering metrics covering code review thoroughness, CI/CD deployment velocity, test automation coverage, production defect leakage, AI tool adoption gains, and design pattern adoption.
* Resource & Performance Optimization: Direct engineering teams in designing systems optimized for runtime performance, memory footprints, thread management, database query efficiency, low-latency API response times, and high-concurrency workloads.
* Team Management, Coaching & Stakeholder Alignment
* People Leadership & Mentorship: Lead, coach, and empower Software Development Engineers (SDEs), tech leads, and full stack teams, fostering an inclusive culture of continuous learning, engineering craftsmanship, and innovation.
* Stakeholder & Risk Management: Partner with business owners, TPMs, and Product Managers to assess technical and schedule risks, evaluate trade-offs between delivery timelines and architectural runway, and communicate complex risks clearly to executive stakeholders.
* Issue & Blocker Resolution: Proactively anticipate bottlenecks, drive escalation management, mitigate multi-level delivery risks, and facilitate constructive technical dialogues to resolve discordant viewpoints.
* Governance, Risk & Controls
* Risk & Compliance Safeguarding: Appropriately assess risk in all technical and architectural decisions, safeguarding the firm’s assets, client data, and reputation.
* Policy Compliance: Ensure strict adherence to information security standards, data privacy laws, regulatory mandates, cryptographic standards, AI usage policies, and secure SDLC controls, escalating and reporting issues with complete transparency.

**Qualifications & Skills**
**Experience & Education**

* Experience: 10–12+ years of progressive software development experience with at least 3–5 years in a technical leadership / engineering management role driving full stack, microservices, and mobile/web development.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

**Core Technical Competencies**

* Backend & Microservices:

+ Deep expertise in Java (Java 17/21), Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate/JPA, and microservices design patterns (Circuit Breaker, Saga, CQRS, Event Sourcing).
+ Solid background in distributed messaging systems (e.g., Apache Kafka, IBM MQ, RabbitMQ).
+ Experience with SQL (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis) databases, schema design, and query optimization.

* Frontend & Web Development:

+ Advanced proficiency in Angular (v14+), TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, SCSS/CSS3, and state management (NgRx/RxJS).
+ Strong understanding of modern frontend build tools, micro-frontends architecture, web performance tuning, and cross-browser/responsive UI design.

* API & Integration:

+ Proven track record designing and securing RESTful APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, GraphQL, and integration with API Gateways.

* Mobile Development Experience:

+ Solid understanding of mobile application architecture (iOS/Android native integration, hybrid frameworks, responsive web/PWA), mobile security best practices, and mobile API orchestration (BFF patterns).

* AI Tools & GenAI Integration (Preferred / Desired):

+ Practical exposure to AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, AI coding assistants, automated unit test generators, AI code review tools).
+ Familiarity with integrating GenAI APIs/LLM endpoints, AI gateways, prompt engineering patterns, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) concepts, or intelligent chat/search capabilities into enterprise applications.
+ Awareness of AI governance, data privacy, and security guardrails for enterprise AI usage.

* Cloud & DevOps:

+ Experience deploying containerized workloads on Kubernetes / Red Hat OpenShift / Docker and public/private cloud environments (AWS, Cloud Foundry, Akamai).
+ Proficiency in CI/CD pipeline automation (Tekton, Jenkins, Harness, GitLab CI), automated testing frameworks (JUnit, Mockito, Jasmine, Karma, Cypress, Selenium), and static code analysis (SonarQube, Snyk, Checkmarx).

**Leadership & Soft Skills**

+ Proven track record of guiding cross-functional teams without direct authority in matrixed enterprise environments.
+ Strong negotiation, diplomacy, and executive presentation skills to communicate technical concepts to non-technical business partners.
+ Strategic mindset with the ability to define technical roadmaps while remaining capable of deep-diving into architecture and code.
