title: ERP Full Stack Development Lead - MERN & NestJS
description:
**Job Description**
ERP Full Stack Development Lead – MERN & NestJS
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a
**highly experienced, technically strong, and ownership-oriented ERP Full Stack Development Lead**
with deep expertise in
**MERN, NestJS, React.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, and enterprise ERP application development**
.
  
  
This is
**not a conventional developer position**
. The selected individual will be expected to take
**end-to-end technical ownership of the organization's current and upcoming ERP development projects**
, while also leading, mentoring, strengthening, and improving the productivity of the existing development team.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have
**overall software development experience**
, with a minimum of
**5 years of substantial hands-on experience in ERP / enterprise application development**
.
  
  
The person should have practical experience working on an ERP product consisting of
**at least 10 integrated modules**
and should understand not only software development, but also
**business processes, workflows, integrations, data flow, implementation challenges, project estimation, delivery management, debugging, team productivity, and the complete ERP software lifecycle**
.
  
  
We are looking for someone who can operate as a
**technical owner rather than simply a task executor**
.
  
  
**The Expected Outcome From This Role Is:**
**AI-assisted development + Rapid Development + Higher Accuracy + Higher Developer Productivity + Faster Project Delivery + Stronger Development Team**
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* End-to-End ERP Development Ownership
* Take technical ownership of the organization's current and future ERP development projects.
* Understand the complete ERP product architecture, modules, workflows, integrations, dependencies, and technical ecosystem.
* Manage and guide the development lifecycle from requirement analysis → technical design → estimation → development → testing support → deployment → maintenance → enhancement.
* Ensure that development decisions are aligned with long-term ERP product scalability and maintainability.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, bottlenecks, and delivery challenges before they affect projects.
* Establish development standards that can be consistently followed across current and future ERP projects.
* Ensure that new requirements are developed without unnecessarily compromising existing ERP functionality.
* Maintain technical consistency across modules and projects.
* ERP Domain Expertise

The candidate must have
**real-world ERP development experience**
, preferably involving an ERP product with
**10 or more integrated modules**
.
  
  
**Strong Understanding Of Enterprise Workflows Such As:**

* Sales
* Purchase
* Inventory
* Procurement
* Production / Manufacturing
* Finance / Accounts
* CRM
* Service
* HR / Payroll
* Projects
* Reporting & Dashboards
* Master Data
* Approval Workflows
* User & Role Management
* Notifications
* Integrations
* Document Management

The candidate should be capable of understanding a business requirement and translating it into:
  
  
**Business Requirement → ERP Workflow → Technical Design → API → Database → UI → Validation → Testing → Deployment**
The individual should be able to distinguish between a
**quick coding solution**
and a
**proper ERP-grade solution**
that can support future requirements.
  
  

* Full Stack Development

Design, develop, review, optimize, and maintain scalable enterprise applications using:
  
  
Backend
  
  

* NestJS
* Node.js
* TypeScript
* Mongoose ODM
* MongoDB
* REST API development
* API architecture and integration
* Authentication and authorization
* Error handling and validation
* Business logic implementation
* Backend performance optimization

Frontend
  
  

* React.js
* JavaScript / TypeScript
* Redux
* Redux-Saga
* Formik
* React Hook Form (RHF)
* Reusable component development
* Complex enterprise forms
* API integration
* State management
* Frontend performance optimization
* Error handling and user experience

The candidate should be comfortable working across
**both frontend and backend**
, rather than being dependent on separate teams for basic full-stack development requirements.
  
  

* MongoDB & Database Ownership
* Design scalable MongoDB data models for ERP applications.
* Design and optimize Mongoose schemas.
* Write efficient MongoDB queries and aggregations.
* Identify and resolve database performance issues.
* Understand relationships and dependencies between ERP entities.
* Ensure data consistency and integrity across complex business workflows.
* Review database changes before implementation in critical modules.
* Identify potential scalability problems in database design.
* Project Estimation & Delivery Planning

The candidate must be highly capable of converting requirements into
**realistic, technically defensible ETAs**
.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Analyze incoming requirements quickly.
* Break requirements into development tasks.
* Identify dependencies and technical complexity.
* Provide accurate development estimates and ETAs.
* Identify parallelizable development activities.
* Allocate work effectively across developers.
* Track estimated vs. actual development effort.
* Continuously improve estimation accuracy.

The role should be capable of
**assessing and planning ETAs for a high-volume development pipeline, including 100+ new project/change requests or requirements in a month**
, without compromising technical quality.
  
  
The expectation is not simply to provide an ETA, but to build a development system capable of
**predictable and measurable delivery**
.
  
  

* Rapid Development & Faster Delivery

We are specifically looking for a developer who believes in
**rapid, disciplined, and intelligent development**
.
  
  
**The Candidate Should:**

* Develop rapidly without compromising maintainability.
* Minimize unnecessary development cycles.
* Reuse existing components, services, utilities, and patterns wherever appropriate.
* Identify repetitive development activities and automate them.
* Establish reusable development frameworks and standards.
* Reduce rework caused by incomplete analysis or poor implementation.
* Improve developer productivity continuously.
* Identify bottlenecks in the current development process and eliminate them.
* Convert requirements into production-ready functionality quickly and accurately.

**The Objective Is:**
**More quality output in less time — not simply more lines of code.**

* AI-Driven Development

Strong practical adoption of
**AI-assisted software development**
is a core expectation of this position.
  
  
**The Candidate Should Actively Use AI Tools To Improve:**

* Development speed
* Code generation
* Code refactoring
* Debugging
* Error analysis
* API development
* Test case generation
* Documentation
* SQL / MongoDB query assistance
* Technical research
* Requirement analysis
* Code reviews
* Performance optimization
* Repetitive development activities
* Developer productivity

The candidate should not merely know how to use AI tools personally, but should be capable of
**introducing, standardizing, and improving AI-assisted development practices across the entire development team**
.
  
  
**The Candidate Is Expected To Continuously Identify:**
**What can be developed faster with AI?**
**What can be tested more accurately with AI?**
**What can be automated with AI?**
**What repetitive developer activity can be eliminated with AI?**
AI should be treated as a
**development productivity tool**
, while maintaining proper engineering judgment, security, correctness, maintainability, and code quality.
  
  

* Team Leadership & Productivity

This position carries significant responsibility for the
**productivity and technical growth of the development team**
.
  
  
**The Candidate Should:**

* Understand the strengths and weaknesses of the existing developers.
* Assess the technical capability of individual team members.
* Allocate work according to capability and project priority.
* Mentor developers technically.
* Conduct meaningful code reviews.
* Improve development practices across the team.
* Identify productivity issues early.
* Help developers overcome technical blocks.
* Encourage AI-assisted development practices.
* Establish accountability for assigned work.
* Track commitments and delivery.
* Create a culture of ownership rather than dependency.
* Motivate developers toward continuous technical improvement.
* Uplift the overall technical capability of the team.

The expectation is to
**make the team stronger, faster, and more independent over time**
.
  
  

* Ownership & Accountability

The successful candidate must demonstrate a strong
**ownership mindset**
.
  
  
**This Role Requires Someone Who:**

* Takes responsibility for outcomes, not merely assigned tasks.
* Follows a requirement until it reaches completion.
* Does not wait for problems to become escalations.
* Identifies problems proactively.
* Communicates delays and risks early.
* Takes responsibility for technical decisions.
* Follows through on commitments.
* Maintains accountability for project delivery.
* Supports the team when critical issues arise.
* Takes ownership of both successful outcomes and failures.

**We Are Looking For Someone Who Asks:**
**“How do we get this delivered?”**
**Rather Than:**
**“Who is responsible for this?”**

* Code Quality & Technical Standards
* Establish and enforce clean coding standards.
* Conduct effective code reviews.
* Ensure reusable and maintainable architecture.
* Identify technical debt.
* Reduce duplicate and unnecessary code.
* Improve existing implementations where required.
* Establish common patterns for APIs, components, forms, state management, and database operations.
* Ensure proper error handling and validation.
* Maintain development documentation where required.
* Ensure that rapid development does not result in long-term technical debt.
* Git, CI/CD & Deployment

**Strong Working Knowledge Of:**

* Git
* GitHub
* Git branching strategies
* Pull requests
* Code reviews
* Merge conflict resolution
* Release management
* Jenkins
* Continuous Integration
* Continuous Deployment
* Application deployment processes

The candidate should be capable of understanding the complete journey from:
  
  
**Developer → Branch → Code Review → Build → CI/CD → Deployment → Production**
and should be able to troubleshoot failures across this lifecycle.
  
  

* Debugging & Problem Solving

The candidate must possess exceptional debugging and analytical skills.
  
  
**Should Be Able To Independently Investigate:**

* Frontend issues
* Backend issues
* API failures
* Database problems
* Performance issues
* Integration failures
* Production defects
* Data-related issues
* Workflow inconsistencies
* Deployment issues
* Unexpected ERP business behavior

**The Candidate Should Be Capable Of Moving Systematically From:**
**Problem → Root Cause → Solution → Validation → Prevention**
rather than simply applying temporary fixes.
  
  

* Current Product & Future Product Development

The selected individual will be expected to understand the existing ERP product deeply and contribute to its continued evolution.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Analyze existing architecture.
* Identify technical limitations.
* Recommend improvements.
* Improve development standards.
* Build reusable foundations for future modules.
* Support development of new ERP modules.
* Support integrations and third-party APIs.
* Improve application performance and scalability.
* Ensure new developments fit into the overall ERP architecture.
* Help establish the technical foundation for future ERP products and projects.

**Required Experience**
Mandatory
  
  

* 10+ years of overall software development experience.
* Minimum 5 years of hands-on ERP / enterprise application development experience.
* Experience developing or maintaining an ERP/business management application with 10+ integrated modules.
* Strong hands-on experience with NestJS, Node.js, TypeScript, React.js and MongoDB.
* Strong experience with Mongoose ODM.
* Strong experience developing REST APIs.
* Practical experience with Redux and Redux-Saga.
* Experience with Formik and/or React Hook Form.
* Strong Git/GitHub experience.
* Practical Jenkins / CI/CD experience.
* Experience leading or mentoring developers.
* Experience handling complex enterprise workflows.
* Strong understanding of the complete software development lifecycle.

**Preferred ERP Experience**
Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly preferred:
  
  

* ERP
* Business Management Systems
* Inventory Management
* Procurement
* Purchase
* Sales
* CRM
* Manufacturing
* Production
* Finance / Accounting
* Service Management
* HR / Payroll
* Project Management
* Enterprise Reporting
* Workflow & Approval Systems
* Third-party ERP integrations

Required Professional Qualities
  
  
**The Ideal Candidate Should Demonstrate:**

* Strong ownership
* High accountability
* Excellent analytical ability
* Strong problem-solving skills
* Fast learning ability
* Rapid development capability
* Strong technical judgment
* Business-process understanding
* Leadership capability
* Team-building ability
* Excellent debugging ability
* Ability to work under delivery pressure
* Ability to prioritize multiple projects
* Strong communication skills
* Continuous improvement mindset
* AI-first development mindset

What We Expect From This Role
  
  
This role is expected to become a
**key technical pillar of the organization**
.
  
  
**The Selected Individual Should Be Capable Of Progressing From:**
**ERP Developer → Technical Owner → Development Lead → ERP Technical Leadership**
The person should be capable of taking responsibility for the
**entire development ecosystem**
, including:
  
  
**ERP Architecture**
**↓**
**Requirement Understanding**
**↓**
**Technical Analysis**
**↓**
**Estimation & ETA**
**↓**
**Task Allocation**
**↓**
**Rapid Development**
**↓**
**AI-Assisted Development**
**↓**
**Code Review**
**↓**
**Testing Support**
**↓**
**Deployment**
**↓**
**Production Support**
**↓**
**Performance Improvement**
**↓**
**Team Development**
**↓**
**Future Product Development**
Performance Expectations
  
  
Success in this role will be measured not only by individual coding ability, but by the
**overall output of the development function**
.
  
  
**Key Expectations Include:**

* Faster project delivery.
* Improved ETA accuracy.
* Higher development productivity.
* Reduced development rework.
* Reduced recurring defects.
* Better code quality.
* Better ERP workflow implementation.
* Increased reuse of existing components and services.
* Effective adoption of AI development tools.
* Improved team capability.
* Better accountability within the development team.
* Predictable project delivery.
* Successful management of multiple concurrent projects.
* Continuous improvement of the ERP technical architecture.

The Ideal Candidate
  
  
We are looking for an individual who is
**far beyond a conventional developer**
.
  
  
You should be someone who can look at an ERP requirement and understand the
**business problem, workflow, architecture, database, API, frontend, development effort, team allocation, delivery timeline, testing requirements, deployment implications, and future scalability**
.
  
  
You should be comfortable getting hands-on with the code while simultaneously
**leading the team and improving the development process**
.
  
  
You should be able to take an existing team, understand its capabilities, identify its weaknesses, introduce better development practices, actively adopt AI-assisted development, and progressively make the entire team
**faster, more accurate, more accountable, and more productive**
.
  
  
We are looking for someone who does not simply ask:
  
  
**“What should I develop?”**
**We Are Looking For Someone Who Asks:**
**“What needs to be delivered, how can we build it correctly and rapidly, how can AI accelerate it, how can the team deliver it, and how can we continuously improve the way we build our ERP?”**
If you are an experienced ERP technology professional who can take
**technical ownership, lead people, solve complex problems, drive AI-powered development, and deliver enterprise software at speed**
, this role is intended for you.

title: Full Stack Developer (JAVA) - Software Engineer II
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Consultant, Full Stack Engineer - Java Backend
  
  
Deloitte Consulting Products (USI)
  
  
**About The Role**
Join a collaborative team delivering production-grade web applications that create real business impact. As a Consultant , you will design and build enterprise-scale solutions across both backend and frontend, with a focus on API development and seamless integration. You’ll use modern AI tools to boost productivity, work with technologies like Docker for deployment, and help guide projects from planning to delivery. This role offers a chance to work on innovative projects blending predictive analytics and cutting-edge technology, while mentoring junior engineers and partnering with global teams.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-quality web applications across backend and frontend.
* Translate Figma or similar UI designs to functional features using React.js, NextJs , and TypeScript.
* Build and operate RESTful APIs and services using Java (Spring Boot or similar), including robust authentication and security integrations (OAuth2/JWT, mTLS , etc.).
* Integrate frontend components with backend logic via secure APIs.
* Containerize applications using Docker and optionally orchestrate with Kubernetes.
* Implement and enforce best practices for testing (JUnit, Jest), code quality, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Optimize for performance and scalability across the full stack.
* Work closely with DevOps, data scientists, and product managers to ship features efficiently.
* Actively use and promote advanced AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT plugins) to improve development productivity.
* Mentor team members and contribute to a collaborative, innovation-driven engineering culture.

Reporting Relationships
  
  
Reports to a Senior Consultant or Manager within IDT. Liaises with onsite/offshore teams to understand functional requirements and may mentor or direct junior team members on a need basis.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* 3 to 5 years of professional experience in full stack engineering roles.
* Expert-level experience in Java( 8+) for backend development, must have shipped production APIs using Spring Boot or similar frameworks.
* Strong frontend skills: React.js, NextJs , TypeScript, Material UI/component libraries.
* Demonstrated use of AI-oriented development tools and plugins (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI).
* Deep experience with Docker, Git, automated testing frameworks, and CI/CD tooling.
* Strong understanding of data persistence, including RDBMS & SQL (or NoSQL), normalization, complex query troubleshooting, and ORM/JPA (e.g., Hibernate) for performant and transactional data access.
* Familiarity with PostgreSQL/SQL and caching (e.g., Redis).
* Cloud experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP is a plus.
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, and team collaboration skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science , Engineering, or related technical field.

**Preferred**

* Experience in agentic/AI-driven architectures or workflow orchestration.
* Familiarity with artifact management (e.g., JFrog ), DevOps toolchain, and secure code/container practices.
* Knowledge of secrets managers, such as Doppler, and code/documentation tools.
* Working experience with Node/Python/. NET-related frameworks.

Why This Role Matters
  
  
This role helps turn complex business needs into secure, scalable web applications that teams can rely on. By combining the technical capabilities outlined above with collaborative delivery practices, the Consultant contributes directly to reliable product outcomes and effective teamwork.
  
  
**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. title: Tech Lead - Full stack
description:
**Career Area**
 Engineering
   

  

**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
 When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
   

  

****Job Description: Full Stack Tech Lead****
**Job Summary: Caterpillar Trimble Control Technologies (CTCT) is a joint venture between Caterpillar and Trimble whose purpose is to transform the way heavy equipment customers shape the world with solutions that differentiate Caterpillar and Trimble.**
**As a Full Stack Tech Lead for CTCT grade control platform products, you will own the end\-to\-end technical direction for your area — from HW/SW internals through system architecture to production release. You are the deepest technical voice in the room: you shape design and architectural decisions at the CTCT level, resolve the crises no one else can, and set the engineering bar the org treats as the benchmark. You translate complex business and system needs into robust software design, kill complexity that slows the org down, and drive AI\-Native, CI/CD, functional\-safety, and V\&V standards across EW/RW. Ultimately, your leadership ensures the product ships fast, ships safe, and holds a competitive edge on the field.**
**Job Duties \& Responsibilities**
**System \& Architectural Depth**
* CTCT\-Level Architecture: Make design and architectural decisions at the CTCT level with strong systems thinking, translating complex business and system requirements into robust software design.
* End\-to\-End Codebase Command: Hold a deep understanding of the entire EW/RW codebase and system\-wide flows — able to go into HW/SW internals and see the bits and bytes move across multiple features.
* First\-Principles Simplification: Cut architectural complexity and cost/BOM by deleting, not just adding — reducing designs to their essential parts and killing complexity that is slowing the org down.


**Debugging, Reliability \& Safety**
* Crisis\-Grade Debugging: Be the person who resolves any crisis, anywhere in the codebase or the field — including cross\-domain HW/SW issues others get stuck on — regardless of which team owns the code.
* Systemic Fixes: Put fixes in place that stop whole classes of bugs from recurring, not just one\-off patches.
* Reliability Standards Across Teams: Drive reliability and safety standards across EW/RW so the whole product fails safe.


**Delivery Governance, CI/CD \& AI\-Native Engineering**
* Release Governance: Represent your area in the CCB, make go/no\-go release\-blocker calls, and drive SDF, T\-Review, and release\-governance standards across teams.
* CI/CD at Scale: Tailor the SDF and design robust CI/CD across features; drive CI/CD standards and automation across EW/RW.
* AI\-Native Ways of Working: Set the AI\-Native patterns and guardrails others adopt — define prompt / agent standards and QC for AI output, and orchestrate and automate the build\-test\-deploy cycle with AI across teams.
* Velocity, Telemetry \& Data: Improve the team's build system and throughput, remove friction that slows the team down, drive observability across the product, and make decisions from data — not opinion.


**Technical Skills**
* Backend \- C\+\+ or relevant coding languages for backend
* Frontend \- Angular / React based front end designs.
* Communication protocols


**Posting Dates**
 September 18, 2026 \- October 1, 2026
   

  

 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

title: Database Technical Lead
description:
Eligibility Criteria
 



 • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering or a related field
 



 • Minimum 8\+ years of experience in RDBMS Design \& development (SQL Server/ Oracle/ PostgreSQL)
 



 Must\-Have Skills
 



 • Deep understanding of database design principles, normalization/denormalization, and data modeling.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with large datasets, high\-concurrency systems, and production environments.
 



 • Solid knowledge of database security, backup, replication, and high availability setups.
 



 • Proven experience in performance tuning, query optimization, and indexing strategies.
 



 • Ability to manage and process large datasets in production environments.
 



 • Expertise in complex Stored Procedures, , Dynamic SQL, Views, Functions, Triggers
 



 • Experience in leading a database team, assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, and ensuring project timelines.
 



  





 Roles \& Responsibilities
 



 • Lead the design, architecture, and implementation of scalable RDBMS solutions.
 



 • Manage and mentor a team of 2–5 database developers/analysts, providing technical guidance and code reviews.
 



 • Own end\-to\-end project execution: requirements gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
 



 • Collaborate with product managers, architects, and application developers to translate business needs into efficient database designs.
 



 • Drive SQL development (stored procedures, functions, views, triggers, CTEs) with best practices and standards. • Ensure database performance, scalability, and reliability through indexing, partitioning, and query optimization.
 



 • Implement and oversee database DevOps (CI/CD), version control, and release management processes.
 



 • Manage data integrity, security, and compliance requirements.
 



 • Conduct capacity planning, backup/recovery strategy, and disaster recovery setup.
 



 • Provide technical leadership in adopting modern practices such as cloud RDBMS, data orchestration (Airflow, dbt), and integration with AI/ML pipelines.
 



 Good\-to\-Have Skills
 



 • Exposure to LLM\-driven architecture and GenAI product integration
 



 • Hands\-on with Vector DBs (e.g., Vespa, Qdrant, FAISS) or Graph DBs (e.g., Neo4j)
 



 • Experience working with LangChain, RAG pipelines, or embedding\-based search systems

* Mentor team members on coding standards, best practices, and technical challenges
* Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, and QA teams to ensure solution alignment
* Conduct code reviews, unit testing, and performance tuning exercises
* Troubleshoot application and system issues, enhancing system resilience and scalability
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and daily stand\-ups within Agile methodologies
* Support deployment activities and automate release processes using CI/CD pipelines
* Maintain documentation related to system design, APIs, and deployment procedures
* Stay current with Java and framework updates, evaluating new tools and methodologies


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
* Certifications such as Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) or Java SE certifications are a plus
* Proven leadership experience in managing development teams and delivering enterprise solutions


**Professional Competencies**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills for complex technical challenges
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities
* Leadership qualities to motivate and develop team members
* Adaptability to evolving technologies and project requirements
* Focus on quality, performance, and security standards

title: Full Stack Developer
description:

* Java, Spring Boot, and REST API development
* Angular (or modern JavaScript frameworks) including component\-based architecture and reactive forms
* Database technologies such as SQL, Oracle/PostgreSQL, JPA/Hibernate, and data modelling

title: Full Stack Developer – Python & Azure
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an experienced
 **Full Stack Developer with strong Python and Microsoft Azure expertise** 
 to join our engineering team building and scaling a
 **PCI DSS v4\.0–ready, microservices\-based order processing platform** 
 . This platform running on a secure, private\-network Azure architecture.
 



 You will work across the full stack — from API design and serverless compute to database design and CI/CD — building secure, cost\-efficient, and highly available services in a regulated, payment\-adjacent environment.
 



**What You'll Work On** 



* Design, build, and maintain
 **Python\-based microservices on Azure Functions** 
 (Python 3\.11/3\.12\) across domains such as order intake, customer management, catalog, orchestration, tax, payment/PCI, fulfillment, notifications, and support APIs.
* Build and secure APIs exposed through
 **Azure API Management (APIM)** 
 — including authentication, throttling, CORS, brand\-scoped RBAC, and correlation\-ID based tracing.
* Work within a
 **Private VNet architecture** 
 , integrating Function Apps, Private Endpoints, NSGs, and NAT Gateway–based outbound connectivity to third\-party partners (payment gateways, tax providers, OMS, email/mail services).
* Design and maintain schemas in a
 **shared Azure SQL Database** 
 using module\-owned table prefixes, optimizing for cost and performance at moderate transaction volume.
* Implement
 **secrets and credential management via Azure Key Vault** 
 using Managed Identity — ensuring no hardcoded credentials anywhere in the platform.
* Build
 **tokenized payment integrations** 
 (e.g., CyberSource/PayPal) ensuring PAN/CVV data never touches application code or storage — token\-only handling.
* Contribute to
 **PCI DSS v4\.0 compliance controls** 
 : network segmentation, encryption in transit/at rest, access logging, audit trails, and secure system design.
* Support
 **queue\- and timer\-triggered async processing** 
 (cron/orchestration patterns) for order lifecycle management with retry logic.
* Collaborate on
 **cost\-optimization decisions** 
 — right\-sizing Function plans (Elastic Premium), SQL tiers, and reserved capacity planning.
* Monitor and troubleshoot production systems using
 **Application Insights, Log Analytics, and Microsoft Defender for Cloud** 
 .
* Partner with stakeholders to translate deployment architecture and solution design into working, well\-tested code.



  





 Requirements
 



**What We're Looking For** 




**Required:** 



* 6–9 years of professional software development experience, with strong full\-stack capability.
* Deep hands\-on experience with
 **Python** 
 (3\.x) for backend/microservice development.
* Solid experience building and deploying on
 **Microsoft Azure** 
 , specifically:
* Azure Functions (serverless compute, VNet integration)
* Azure API Management
* Azure SQL Database
* Azure Key Vault \& Managed Identity
* Azure VNet, NSGs, Private Endpoints, NAT Gateway
* Experience designing
 **RESTful APIs** 
 and microservices architectures.
* Experience with
 **relational database design** 
 (schema design, query optimization, TDE/encryption\-at\-rest concepts).
* Understanding of
 **secure application design** 
 : secrets management, least\-privilege access, RBAC, TLS/encryption in transit.
* Familiarity with
 **asynchronous/queue\-based or timer\-based processing patterns** 
 .
* Experience integrating with
 **third\-party APIs** 
 (payment gateways, tax engines, OMS, email/notification providers, etc.).
* Working knowledge of
 **monitoring/observability tools** 
 (Application Insights, Log Analytics or equivalent).
* Strong understanding of
 **CI/CD pipelines** 
 and cloud deployment practices.



**Preferred / Nice to Have:** 



* Experience working in a
 **PCI DSS–regulated environment** 
 .
* Exposure to
 **e\-commerce order management systems** 
 (Shopify, OMS platforms, or similar).
* Experience with
 **tokenized payment processing** 
 (CyberSource, PayPal, Stripe, or similar gateways).
* Familiarity with
 **Infrastructure as Code** 
 (Bicep, ARM templates, or Terraform on Azure).
* Front\-end development experience (React/Angular/Vue) for full\-stack contributions beyond APIs.
* Experience with
 **cost optimization** 
 on cloud platforms (reserved capacity, right\-sizing).
* Azure certifications (e.g., AZ\-204, AZ\-400, AZ\-305\) are a plus.



**Soft Skills** 



* Strong ownership mindset — comfortable working across the stack from database to API to deployment.
* Ability to work in a security\- and compliance\-conscious environment with attention to detail.
* Clear communicator, able to work with architects and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Comfortable in a fast\-paced environment balancing scalability, security, and cost.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Title:** 
 AI/GenAI– Manager
   

  

**Educational qualification:** 
 BTech/Masters/PhD
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are seeking an experienced GenAI Manager with 10\+ years of overall experience, including significant hands\-on expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG architectures, Conversational AI, and enterprise AI platforms. The ideal candidate will lead the design, delivery, governance, and scaling of AI solutions while managing cross\-functional teams of AI engineers, data scientists, architects, and business stakeholders.
   

  

 The role requires a strong blend of technical leadership, solution architecture, AI strategy, delivery management, and stakeholder engagement to drive enterprise\-wide adoption of GenAI capabilities. The candidate should have proven experience delivering AI\-powered solutions such as RAG applications, AI agents, copilots, knowledge management platforms, AI automation workflows, and multi\-agent systems, while ensuring Responsible AI, quality, security, and scalability standards are met.
   

  

 The individual will lead AI quality, validation, and governance initiatives to ensure the reliability, security, performance, and scalability of enterprise AI and GenAI solutions while partnering with technical and business teams.
   

  

**Important:** 
 Hands\-on experience delivering AI solutions in enterprise or production environments is required. Certifications, personal projects, and demos alone are not sufficient.
   

  

**Application Guidance:** 
 Candidates should be able to explain at least two AI/GenAI implementations, including the business use case, their contribution, technical approach, and measurable outcomes.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the design, development, and delivery of enterprise AI, GenAI, Agentic AI, and RAG\-based solutions aligned with business objectives.
* Define AI strategy, roadmaps, governance frameworks, and operating models to enable scalable AI adoption across the organization.

* Oversee the end\-to\-end AI solution lifecycle, including ideation, architecture, development, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Lead and mentor cross\-functional teams of AI engineers, data scientists, architects, and developers, fostering innovation and delivery excellence.
* Establish best practices for Responsible AI, security, privacy, compliance, and risk management across AI implementations.
* Drive adoption of enterprise AI capabilities leveraging Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI, Databricks, vector databases, and modern AI frameworks.
* Ensure AI solutions are scalable, reliable, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture and governance standards.
* Partner with engineering and business teams to define evaluation frameworks, quality standards, and performance metrics for AI systems.
* Guide the implementation of RAG architectures, knowledge management solutions, and agentic workflows to enhance business productivity and decision\-making.
* Manage stakeholder communication, executive reporting, budgeting, resource planning, and delivery governance for AI programs.
* Stay current with emerging trends in GenAI, Agentic AI, multimodal AI, AI agents, and enterprise AI platforms to drive innovation and competitive advantage.
* Contribute to capability building, reusable accelerators, reference architectures, and thought leadership across the AI practice.


**Skills and Attributes:**
**Professional Experience**
* 10\+ years of overall experience, including 5\+ years leading AI/ML, GenAI, or data\-driven transformation initiatives in enterprise environments.
* Proven experience delivering and scaling production\-grade AI, GenAI, Agentic AI, Copilot, and RAG\-based solutions from concept through deployment and adoption.
+ Strong understanding of enterprise AI architecture and hands\-on exposure to multiple areas, including:
+ LLM and GenAI application development
+ RAG architectures and knowledge management solutions
+ Agentic AI and multi\-agent systems
+ Conversational AI and Copilot solutions
+ AI evaluation, governance, and Responsible AI
+ AI platform engineering and cloud\-based deployments
+ MLOps / LLMOps and operationalization of AI solutions
+ Data engineering, vector databases, and retrieval pipelines

* Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional teams of AI engineers, architects, data scientists, and developers.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with experience translating business needs into scalable AI solutions and measurable business outcomes.
* Experience with enterprise AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI, Databricks, Microsoft Copilot, and related AI ecosystems.


**Educational Background**
* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field.


**Technical Skills**
* Strong understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, Agentic AI, Multi\-Agent Systems, and RAG architectures.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise\-scale GenAI, Copilot, Conversational AI, and AI Agent solutions.
* Experience defining AI strategy, solution roadmaps, architecture standards, and operating models.
* Strong knowledge of AI platform ecosystems including Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Databricks, Vector Databases, and Enterprise Search platforms.
* Experience leading the design and implementation of RAG pipelines, knowledge management solutions, and AI\-powered business applications.
* Understanding of AI evaluation, guardrails, observability, quality metrics, and Responsible AI practices.
* Experience establishing governance frameworks covering AI security, privacy, compliance, safety, and risk management.
* Strong knowledge of prompt engineering, agent orchestration frameworks, tool integrations, and workflow automation.
* Experience managing the end\-to\-end AI lifecycle, including ideation, development, deployment, monitoring, and adoption.
* Proven ability to lead and mentor AI engineers, architects, data scientists, and cross\-functional delivery teams.
* Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, cloud platforms, and business processes.
* Strong understanding of MLOps, LLMOps, model monitoring, performance optimization, and operationalization of AI solutions.
* Ability to work with executive stakeholders to identify AI opportunities, define business value, and drive adoption.
* Experience with enterprise architecture, software engineering best practices, scalability, reliability, and secure solution design.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills.


**Soft Skills**
* Excellent problem\-solving and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to translate AI capabilities into measurable business outcomes and enterprise value.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills, with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences.


**Other Responsibilities:**
* Lead the delivery of enterprise GenAI, Agentic AI, and RAG solutions, from ideation through deployment and business adoption.
* Define AI strategy, solution roadmaps, governance frameworks, and best practices to drive scalable AI adoption.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to identify opportunities, prioritize use cases, and deliver measurable business value.
* Mentor and lead cross\-functional teams of AI engineers, architects, and data scientists, ensuring delivery excellence and innovation.
* Drive AI governance, Responsible AI, security, compliance, and operational readiness across all AI initiatives.


**Why Join Us**
* Be at the forefront of AI\-driven innovation across multiple client sectors.
* Work with global clients to drive real business impact.
* Collaborate with a team of AI experts, analytics leaders, and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment.


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 The KLA Services team headquartered in Milpitas, CA is our service organization that consists of Service Sales and Marketing, Spares Supply Chain management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, and Technical Support. The KLA Services organization partners with our field teams and customers in all business sectors to maintain the high performance and productivity of our products through a flexible portfolio of services. Our comprehensive services include: proactive management of tools to identify and improve performance; expertise in optics, image processing and motion control with worldwide service engineers, 24/7 technical support teams and knowledge management systems; and an extensive parts network to ensure worldwide availability of parts.
   

  

**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**

Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
